verdict.rationale: A government corporate registry could plausibly offer a natural-language or conversational interface, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents web forms (the Online Filing Centre), PDF filing, and email notices. The probe found a keyless open-data JSON API at open.canada.ca, which is a developer building block rather than natural-language operation, and it reports no transactional API for the registry itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
